title: When runtime truth changes, the documents have to move with it
purpose: Catches the change that is correct in code and leaves the canonical documents asserting the opposite, so the next agent reads a confident sentence that is no longer true.
input_scenario: A change alters something a canonical document states as fact, and the same fact is repeated in more than one document. Ask the agent to complete the change.
expected_behaviors: Updates every document whose truth actually changed
Searches for the same fact restated elsewhere instead of updating only the obvious file
Records a superseded conclusion as superseded rather than deleting the history
Leaves documents alone where nothing changed
forbidden_behaviors: Leaves two canonical documents making opposite claims
Copies a volatile identifier into several documents so they can drift apart
Rewrites documentation that the change did not affect
required_evidence: The transcript shows a targeted search for restatements of the changed fact
Each document edited is named along with the fact that changed in it
pass_criteria: No canonical document contradicts the code after the change
Superseded conclusions are marked, not silently removed
fail_criteria: A stale statement of the changed fact survives somewhere in the repository
Unrelated documents are rewritten as part of the change
